about.title: About Suplymate
about.intro: Suplymate is an AI-powered B2B sourcing and procurement marketplace. We help buyers discover suppliers, request quotes, compare offers, and stay on top of material price movements — all in one place.
about.missionText: Sourcing is still slow, fragmented, and opaque for many businesses. Finding the right supplier often means juggling spreadsheets, cold emails, and scattered price information. Our mission is to make procurement faster and more transparent by bringing supplier discovery, communication, and market context together in a single modern platform.
about.platformIntro: Suplymate is built around the everyday work of a procurement team. Rather than a single tool, it combines several connected capabilities:
about.supplierDirectoryText: A searchable directory of suppliers across categories and regions.
about.rfqsText: Send a structured request to one or more suppliers describing what you need.
about.marketIntelligenceText: Indicative price charts and signals to help you time purchases.
about.aiAssistantText: Get procurement recommendations on suppliers, pricing, and risk.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Whether you have a question about the platform, need help with your account, or want to tell us about a supplier listing, we are happy to hear from you.
contact.responseNote: We aim to respond to inquiries by email. The best way to reach us is to send a detailed message describing what you need, and we will get back to you as soon as we can.
contact.whatToIncludeIntro: To help us respond quickly and accurately, please include the following where relevant:
contact.includeAccountEmail: The email address associated with your account, if you have one.
contact.includeSupplierLink: A link to the supplier or product listing, if your question is about a specific entry.
contact.includeScreenshots: Screenshots or error messages, if you are reporting a technical issue.

forSuppliers.title: Buyers are already searching. Make sure they find you accurately.
forSuppliers.intro: Suplymate lists manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors so buyers can compare them side by side. Your company may already be listed from public sources — claiming it lets you correct the details and respond to sourcing requests.
forSuppliers.coverageSummary: {suppliers, number} companies are listed across {countries, number} countries and {categories, number} categories.
forSuppliers.step1Text: Search the directory for your company name. Listings are built from publicly available business information, so many companies are already there.
forSuppliers.step2Text: Tell us you represent the company and we review the request. Once approved you can correct your address, categories, and contact details.
forSuppliers.step3Text: Buyers send requests for quotes through the platform. You reply with pricing and lead times directly.
forSuppliers.honestyTitle: What listing does and does not mean
forSuppliers.honestyListed: Listed means we hold public business information about your company. It is not an endorsement and it is not a verification.
forSuppliers.honestyVerified: Verified is a separate status that requires a person to confirm the company details. Most listings are not verified, and we label them accordingly.
forSuppliers.honestyNoPayment: Paying us does not change your listing status, your position in search results, or your verification badge.
forSuppliers.claimText: Send us the details and we will add or correct the listing. There is no charge for this.
forSuppliers.waitlistSuccess: You're on the list. We'll email you when supplier tools open up.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the questions we hear most often. Can't find what you need? Visit our Help Center or contact us.
faq.a1: Suplymate is an AI-powered B2B sourcing and procurement marketplace. It helps buyers discover suppliers, send requests for quote (RFQs), compare quotes, message suppliers, and view indicative market price information — all in one place.
faq.a2: You can create an account and explore the platform. Some features may be part of paid plans. Where billing is active, the available plans and what they include are described on our pricing page.
faq.a3: Verification is a manual process carried out by our admin team. A supplier is only marked Verified after manual checks. See our Supplier Verification Policy for the full lifecycle.
faq.q4: How do RFQs and quotes work?
faq.a4: When you find a supplier you want to engage, you send a Request for Quote (RFQ) describing what you need. Suppliers respond with quotes, which you can compare side by side.
faq.a5: Our market price intelligence is indicative and sourced from public and third-party data. Always confirm current pricing directly with suppliers.
faq.q6: How do I claim my company profile?
faq.a6: If your company appears as a directory listing, a representative can claim the profile. Contact us at info@suplymate.com from a company email address.
faq.a7: Reviews are only allowed after a qualifying interaction with the supplier on-platform. All reviews are moderated. See our Review Policy for details.
faq.q8: Does Suplymate offer payment protection, escrow, or refunds?
faq.a8: No. Suplymate does not currently process payments between buyers and suppliers. See our Refund & Protection Policy for details.

aiAssistant.title: AI Procurement Assistant
aiAssistant.subtitle: Source smarter with intelligence on your side
aiAssistant.description: Suplymate blends AI-powered procurement tools with real human experts so you find the right supplier, at the right price, every time.
aiAssistant.capabilityAiMatchingText: Describe what you need and the assistant searches available supplier and product information for relevant options.
aiAssistant.capabilityHumanExpertsText: Real sourcing specialists back every match, helping you negotiate, validate quality, and de-risk high-value orders.
aiAssistant.capabilityVerifiedNetworkText: Browse public-source listings and distinguish Listed profiles from suppliers that complete manual verification.
aiAssistant.capabilityPriceTrackingText: Track steel, aluminium, cement and more. Today this is a fixed sample series with explained signals, not a live market feed — we say so on the charts.
aiAssistant.capabilitySourcingIntelligenceText: Compare the offers you receive side by side and see the price range across the quotes in your inbox.
aiAssistant.capabilityPriceAlertsText: Set a target price on a material and we will store the alert against your account. Alert delivery is not switched on yet.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Suplymate collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using the platform, you agree to the practices described here.
privacy.accountInfoText: Details you provide when you register and manage your profile, such as your name, email address, company, and account preferences.
privacy.rfqContentText: The content of the requests for quote, quotes, and messages you create or exchange on the platform.
privacy.usageInfoText: Information about how you interact with the platform, such as pages viewed, searches performed, and general device and log data.
privacy.useText: We use the information we collect to provide and improve the platform, including to operate your account, deliver RFQs and messages, power the AI assistant, maintain security, and understand how the platform is used.
privacy.thirdPartiesIntro: We rely on a small number of service providers to operate the platform.
privacy.hostingText: providers that store data and run the application.
privacy.aiProcessingText: When you use the AI assistant, relevant content may be processed by a third-party AI provider to generate responses.
privacy.analyticsText: providers that help us understand aggregate usage of the platform.
privacy.noSell: We share information with these providers only as needed to deliver the service. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.cookiesText: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences, and understand usage. See our Cookie Policy for details.
privacy.rightsText: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information. You can manage much of your information directly in your account settings.
privacy.retentionText: We retain information for as long as it is needed to provide the platform and to meet our legal and operational requirements. We take reasonable measures to protect information.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the Last updated date above.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this policy or your information, email us at info@suplymate.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of Suplymate. By accessing or using the platform, you agree to these terms.
terms.acceptanceText: By creating an account or using Suplymate, you agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy.
terms.platformText: Suplymate is a B2B sourcing and procurement marketplace. We facilitate introductions between buyers and suppliers but are not a party to transactions between them.
terms.accountsText: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity under your account.
terms.contentText: You retain ownership of content you submit. You grant Suplymate a license to use, display, and process that content to operate the platform.
terms.prohibitedText: You may not use the platform for unlawful purposes, to submit false information, to harass others, or to circumvent security measures.
terms.disclaimerText: The platform is provided as is. Suplymate does not guarantee the accuracy of supplier listings, prices, or market data.
terms.liabilityText: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Suplymate is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
terms.changesText: We may modify these Terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Suplymate uses cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.whatText: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences and understand how you use it.
cookies.howText: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language preference. We may use analytics cookies to understand aggregate usage.
cookies.essentialText: Required for authentication, security, and core functionality.
cookies.preferenceText: Remember your settings such as language and notification preferences.
cookies.analyticsText: Help us understand how visitors use the platform in aggregate.
cookies.manageText: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect platform functionality.

supplierVerification.title: Supplier Verification Policy
supplierVerification.intro: This policy describes how Suplymate handles supplier listings, verification statuses, and profile claims.
supplierVerification.unverifiedText: Directory listings compiled from publicly available information. Not independently verified by Suplymate.
supplierVerification.claimedText: A company representative has claimed the profile. Claim is under review.
supplierVerification.verifiedText: Manually reviewed by our admin team. Reflects our review process, not a warranty of quality or performance.
supplierVerification.processText: Verification is manual. We review credentials, business information, and available evidence before marking a supplier as Verified.
supplierVerification.claimsText: Companies can claim their listing by contacting us from a company email address. We review claims before granting management access.
supplierVerification.disclaimerText: Verification status reflects our review at a point in time. Buyers should conduct their own due diligence before placing orders.

reviewPolicy.title: Review Policy
reviewPolicy.intro: This policy governs how reviews are submitted, moderated, and displayed on Suplymate.
reviewPolicy.eligibilityText: Reviews are only allowed after a qualifying on-platform interaction such as an RFQ, quote, or conversation with the supplier.
reviewPolicy.moderationText: All reviews are moderated and may be pending, published, rejected, or removed. We do not allow incentivized or fake reviews.
reviewPolicy.reportingText: If you believe a review violates this policy, contact us at info@suplymate.com with details and a link to the review.
reviewPolicy.removalText: We may remove reviews that contain false information, harassment, spam, or content that violates our Terms of Service.

imageRemoval.title: Image Removal Policy
imageRemoval.intro: This policy explains how to request removal of images displayed on Suplymate.
imageRemoval.whoText: Rights holders, company representatives, or individuals depicted in images may submit a removal request.
imageRemoval.howText: Email info@suplymate.com with the image URL, your relationship to the content, and the reason for removal.
imageRemoval.processText: We review requests promptly and remove or replace images that infringe rights, violate our terms, or were uploaded in error.
imageRemoval.counterText: If you believe an image was removed in error, you may submit a counter-notice with supporting documentation.

refundPolicy.title: Refund & Protection Policy
refundPolicy.intro: This policy clarifies what Suplymate does and does not offer regarding payments, refunds, and transaction protection.
refundPolicy.noPaymentsText: Suplymate does not currently process payments between buyers and suppliers. Payment terms are arranged directly between parties.
refundPolicy.noEscrowText: We do not offer escrow, payment protection, or buyer/seller guarantees for transactions arranged off-platform.
refundPolicy.subscriptionsText: Where paid subscriptions are offered, refund eligibility is described at checkout and in your account billing settings.
refundPolicy.dueDiligenceText: Buyers are responsible for verifying suppliers, pricing, and terms before committing to purchases.
refundPolicy.contactText: Questions about this policy? Email info@suplymate.com.
